positions.title: Software Engineer (FUEL Mobile Team)
positions.description:
- Developed UI for Android/IOS games running on top of the Unity game engine; business logic written in C#.
- Followed design mock-ups and tested code against different screen sizes to ensure an uncompromised UX experience.
- Worked with artists to determine what types of UX animations were technically feasible to implement on mobile phones.
- Participated in code reviews as both an author and a reviewer to ensure consistent, high quality code.
- Reduced memory usage by identifying assets that can be replaced with substitutes with smaller memory footprints.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Core Technology Team)
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, and documented new features for the presentation layer of a next generation UI framework (including tools); all development executed under SCRUM and TDD practices.
- Wrote unit tests for all features to ensure all acceptance criteria were met and can be properly regressed in the future.
- Provided dev support for the customer teams, recommending best practices as well as providing fixes at the framework level. Helped teams migrate to our framework by creating equivalent screens using our UI technology.
- Released new versions of our team’s UI framework; merged and integrated changes by the customer teams, resolved broken builds, created packages, and generated release notes and announcements.
- Gathered performance metrics by creating performance intensive UI screens and bootflows, and profiling runtime.
- Gathered production metrics by investigating the output of customer teams who are using our tools.
- Demonstrated the usage of our tools to customer teams who are evaluating our technology to ensure product quality.

positions.title: Co-Founder and Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed social networking iOS app Social151, a social events aggregator for university students.
- Lead and developed entire server back end on Amazon EC2, with Apache 2.2 software.
- Designed and implemented all server side scripts using the Django Python and PostgreSQL.
- Designed API for mobile application to connect securely to the server, implementing asymmetric encryption methods such as HTTPS and AES cryptography, as well as iOS view controllers to communicate with the server.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
- Performed all firmware regression testing for a multi-rate, multi-protocol, transport microchip.
- Coded firmware test scripts in Tcl/Tk to automate test suites, configuration of data paths within the chip, and communication with the firmware's host message system.
- Utilized JTAG debugger to find bugs uncovered by customers and performed fixes in C and Assembly.
- Designed and coded a new automated build script for the team using Python, automating build tasks, including repository access, source code compilation, error checking, and generation of documentation.
- Designed and implemented a new testing infrastructure for the firmware team, including an automated test dispatcher, automated test reporting, a full featured web application which stores and organizes test case/results in a SQL database; Tcl/Tk and Python were used.

positions.title: Product Design Engineer
positions.description:
- Coded and debugged Linux Shell, Perl, and Tcl/Tk scripts to parse static timing data of a RAID controller microchip, acquiring transistor gate counts and overall power consumption.
- Analyzed static timing requirements, RTL code, and standard cell specifications to resolve all timing violations at the block level; Coordinated with block owners to reduce the functional delay of the chip.
- Constructed XML documents to automate STA script generation and to enable post processing of data.

positions.title: IT Systems Support
positions.description:
- Provided technical support for the company's global computer network.
- Performed administration duties, such as web authentication and VLAN/VPN establishment, on Windows Server 2003, Active Directory and DHCP; regulating domain controllers and admin servers.
- Implemented MS-DOS scripts to oversee the status of the computer network.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
- Provided technical support for the company’s 350 retail locations across Canada.
- Configured and maintained network infrastructures, including the establishment of VPNs and VLANs.
- Regulated and maintained domain controllers and administration servers. (DNS entry, web auth, etc.)
- Planned, prepared, and shipped computer and telephone equipment for all new retail stores, including the configuration of SonicWALL routers and assembly of NORDX BIXs.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
- Managed own business selling educational books door to door in Toronto, Ontario.
- Executed all ordering, inventory, accounting, sales, and delivery of product.
- Worked over 80 hours a week for 13 weeks throughout the summer.
- Completed over 3000 sales calls and demonstrated products to over 1500 customers.

projects.title: SortIT - Efficient recycling through computer vision
projects.description: SortIT is an electronic device which aims at educating users on recycling practices. We are currently undergoing prototype tests and design refinement.

projects.title: SortIT - More efficient recycling through computer vision
projects.description:
SortIT is a product being designed and implemented by our start-up Ciphra. It is an electronic device which aims at educating and guiding users on how to dispose their garbage while they are standing in front of garbage receptacles.
We are currently developing the second prototype for SortIT as well as organizing a focus group, usability test and field tests.
Our team will be participating in two business competitions in the March; STU Clark and Pacific Venture Capital Competition.
